name: Zipporah
overview: The Scripture introduces Zipporah as the daughter of Reuel (also called Jethro), the priest of Midian, whose seven daughters Moses aided by watering their flock after shepherds had driven them away. Impressed by Moses, Reuel welcomed him to dwell with them and gave Zipporah to Moses as his wife. This narrative highlights Zipporah's role in Moses' life during his time in Midian, setting the stage for later interactions involving reproach and separation, as well as the tensions with Miriam and Aaron concerning her.
